title: Signature Fair-Share Allocation
description: Signature Fair-Share Allocation is a storage ability in the Signature Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Divides total network storage fairly among peers by stake and need. Each peer's share is proportional to their contributed storage, recomputed as peers join or leave. It takes peer list, contributions and produces share table. Tunable parameters: proportional. Guarantee: shares always sum to the total. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.
